name: muse
label: Muse Code
description: Meta's Muse Code terminal coding agent (Muse Spark models), driven headlessly with `muse exec --json`
tagline: Meta's terminal coding agent on Muse Spark — sandboxed by default, driven headlessly.

env_config.name: META_API_KEY
env_config.description: Meta Model API key (Meta Developer Console). Optional if you signed in on this machine with `muse login` — when set, it overrides that login.

env_config.name: MUSE_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id. Leave empty for the CLI default.

env_config.name: MUSE_REASONING_EFFORT
env_config.description: Reasoning effort for each run. Leave empty for the CLI default (high).

env_config.name: MUSE_MAX_MODEL_STEPS
env_config.description: Cap on model steps per message. Leave empty for the CLI default.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not signed in — set META_API_KEY (press e) or run: muse login
